title: spark/1 payload
description: The common format (design/layout-db/22-spark-spec.md): cmini's positions, the magic-rules authoring shape from design/magic-rules/02-schema.md, plus a raw-rule escape hatch. There is NO board field (design/layout-db/26-no-board.md): a record says where its keys sit and which finger presses each, never what physical board it is drawn on -- the board is the reader's own choice (the site's rowstag/ortho comparison view, the bot's engine context), so 23-geometry.md's one-word `board` is gone along with its object predecessor. 21-formats.md D10 dropped the free-form `x` field; 23-geometry.md dropped the `TB` finger (its section 4.2: a thumb key's label IS its hand), and its own duplicate-characters follow-up replaced the char-keyed `keys` map (plus a separate `free` array) with ONE array of positions -- `char` optional (absent = free), and the SAME char may appear on more than one entry. Single-code-point-ness, cross-field agreement and referential checks (no two entries share (row, col), a magic-named char has at most one entry, etc.) are NOT expressible here -- they live in formats/spark/1/index.ts's validate().

magicDefault.description: design/layout-db/24-spark-wire-review.md finding 6, round 2's resolution item 1: a `kind`-discriminated tagged union, not bare strings -- absent means none (there is no 'none' tag).

chiralValue.description: design/layout-db/24-spark-wire-review.md finding 6, round 2's resolution item F: the SAME kind-tagged union as magicDefault -- a literal character is `{kind:"char",char}`, never a bare string; the 'repeat previous' sentinel is `{kind:"repeat"}`.

magicKeyRule.description: design/layout-db/27-magic-emit.md: after the n-gram `after`, the key emits `emit` -- the lowered row is `after+key -> after+emit`. A magic key never rewrites its context (a row that would is a raw `rules[]` entry). `emit` replaced the old `output` (which repeated the context) on purpose: new meaning, new name.
